# leptonica / pageseg_fuzzer

leptonica's own fuzz target `pageseg_fuzzer` ([source](source/pageseg_fuzzer.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over leptonica (DanBloomberg/leptonica at 10bdea2f).

pixReadMemSpix, then pixDecideIfTable, pixGetRegionsBinary, pixFindPageForeground (input also parsed as a pixacomp) and pixSplitIntoCharacters; outputs discarded.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against leptonica at commit 10bdea2f.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

| statement | in one line | status |
|---|---|---|
| `plain_halts` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | open |
| `ubsan_halts` | on every input on which the UBSan build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | open |
| `asan_halts` | on every input on which the ASan build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | open |
| `asan_ubsan_halts` | on every input on which the ASan+UBSan build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | open |
| `plain_halts_may_fail` | with no memory premise, and even if any request is refused at any time: the plain build exits with any status | open |
| `ubsan_halts_may_fail` | with no memory premise, and even if any request is refused at any time: the UBSan build exits with any status | open |
| `asan_agrees` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 2 GiB (a premise): neither build reaches an error and both have the same set of observable behaviours; ASan never fires | open |
| `ubsan_agrees` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise): neither build reaches an error and both have the same set of observable behaviours; UBSan never fires | open |
| `asan_ubsan_agrees` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 2 GiB (a premise): neither build reaches an error and both have the same set of observable behaviours; ASan+UBSan never fires | open |

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch leptonica` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `pageseg_fuzzer.plain` | 1,210,144 | `340d9342ad2a72158d178480f64ada4d4ec94303c4f26b459db223a4527a1261` |
| ubsan | `pageseg_fuzzer.ubsan` | 1,311,512 | `4b7d6c00350454f8518edcbcf73e0734d994214e318799fe82ec72eab94d2b65` |
| asan | `pageseg_fuzzer.asan` | 2,570,056 | `79608a0e2b428c9e2368139017932a5ea3bbeb1c731fd51c1848bb3ad2439bfd` |
| asan-ubsan | `pageseg_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 2,665,224 | `b62320777ff2a63f375d4976e62e451465e9047705f42e9c84be7bfa7f6d5e0e` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.
